The core rendering logic for vector layers is handled in CanvasVectorLayerRenderer (in src/ol/renderer/canvas/VectorLayer.js), which inherits from CanvasLayerRenderer (src/ol/renderer/canvas/Layer.js). The renderFrame() method is responsible for the entire rendering process per frame, including clearing and drawing. The renderDeclutter() method is important because it manages the rendering of decluttered items, which is relevant to the bug scenario. In CanvasLayerRenderer, the prepareContainer() method manages the reuse and clearing of canvas elements. If opacity < 1, special logic may be needed to ensure full clearing/repainting, and if decluttering changes the rendering flow, clearing may be skipped inadvertently. Therefore, these classes and their methods are central to both the bug manifestation and the likely fix.

When panning the map, previous frames are not cleared, leading to visual artifacts where old renderings remain visible rather than being erased. The attached screenshot shows multiple overlapping renderings of the same features as the map is moved, clearly indicating the canvas is not being cleared properly between frames when both declutter and opacity < 1 are set.
